## Owner And Consumer Coverage

The chosen class is raw/reconstructed authority in the three standalone
activity-journal proofs. All three now consume the original native selected
`WorkflowPersistence`, canonical run/event/reply-context writers and the
already-landed SQLite/PostgreSQL reopen constructors. No G-owned convenience
constructor, location/readback port or hostile fault is introduced.

Execution is native admission -> canonical run/reply construction -> journal
mutation -> detached physical witness -> quiescence join -> exact owner close
-> fresh native reopen -> journal readback. The recording bus remains the
unchanged activity-result oracle. Each constructed native delivery bus joins
before its catalog lease, runtime occurrence and selected-store cleanup;
explicit reopen refuses to close when quiescence fails.

The private `ReadWorkflowJournalStorageForTest` owns the single original
selected read transaction. Its detached evidence preserves whole-store story
count/head and exact-run revision cardinality. Revision SQL stays behind the
existing classified run-fork-revision backend. The public storetest bridge
exports no pool, raw transaction or arbitrary callback. Invalid, closed,
cancelled, missing-head and late-failing owners yield no partial evidence.

Binding specification: `engine.runtime_core_persistence_store_contracts.
selected_contracts.selected_runtime_store_projection`, including the opaque
workflow capability, original selected mutation owner and `raw_sql_policy`.
The authoritative specification now states this bounded journal observation
contract. No production journal/replay semantics change.
